title: olivia-garcia-dx-sdk-daily-scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - DX / SDK docs (working notes)
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Olivia Garcia

TOP PRIORITY (today)
- [ ] Fix Python quickstart that fails on streaming example (users report: exceptions when using `client.stream` with 0.0.7 SDK). Probable cause: README snippet uses old `streaming=True` param. Need to change examples to `client.stream_response(...)` and add note about async/await.
  - TODO: write minimal repro for QA (file: repro/py-stream-issue.py)
  - Blocker: waiting on regression test infra from devops (pinged @Devon)

- [ ] Update Node TS sample app for tool-calling tutorial - code uses `callTool()` helper that was moved to `utilities/calls.ts` in the SDK v2 refactor. Replace snippet and add small explanation about tool schema.
  - Add snippet showing how to register a tool and handle tool responses.
  - Add unit test harness example (jest) showing mocked tool invocation.

BACKLOG / followups
- Improve embeddings quickstart: current doc misses how to persist and batch vectors. Add a short section: "batching strategy + sample using bulkUpsert".
- Add migration note for v1 -> v2: key renames (`create_completion` -> `generate_text`, env var RENAMED) - derive list from sdk-migration.md PR.
- Add missing explanation for Dedicated vs Hosted behavior in SDK: when routing/pinning happens client-side vs server-side. Get input from Solutions Eng.
- Write a mini tutorial: "Build a low-latency chat app with Redwood Dedicated" (skeleton: architecture diagram, batching settings, cache usage tips). Aim to convert to a video/slide later.

BUGS / doc fixes (quick)
- Broken link: "Console rollouts" in "rollouts.md" points to old confluence page. Replace with new console URL. (DOCS-412)
- Outdated screenshot in quickstart: update images to reflect new console UI (search + model selection).
- Typo in TypeScript README: `ResponseOptions` -> `GenerationOptions` (small PR).

NOTES FROM SYNC WITH PRODUCT (3/3)
- Decision needed: default timeout for streaming responses - Product suggests 60s, but Serving Runtime team recommends 120s for longer tokens when KV cache warmed. Put RFC? (assign: Rachael)
- Suggestion: Add a one-page "Cost-conscious settings" guide that lists batching/quantization recommendations per workload (link to Optimize team).

QUICK TODOS (personal)
- [ ] Open PR for python quickstart fix (target: EOD)
- [ ] Draft tutorial outline for Dedicated chat app (target: EOW)
- [ ] Add test cases for node tool-calling snippet (pair with Mikaela)
- [ ] Create small failing example for QA to reproduce streaming bug

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS
- How opinionated should SDK defaults be about batching? (leave off by default and provide helper configs, or enable simple batching for new users?)
- Should we ship sample apps under `examples/` in main repo or a separate `redwood-examples` repo? Pros/cons: discoverability vs repo maintenance.
- Can Applied-ML provide recommended per-model quantization profiles we can show in docs? (Asked @Mikaela)

IDEAS / SAMPLE APPS (short list)
- Chat + knowledge base retrieval (embeddings + rerank) - small Next.js starter, emphasize cache + prefix optimization
- Streaming transcription + summary demo (Show streaming + function calls)
- Realtime Q&A with fallback model variants (show routing policies and how to configure pinning)

REVIEW NOTES / PRS TO ASSIGN
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1234 (Node examples update) - assign to Devon for code review
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/89 (quickstart image update) - ask Design to provide new assets

PERSONAL LOG (timeboxed)
- 09:00-09:20 triage inbox + prioritize bugs
- 09:30-10:00 sync with Mikaela (applied-ml) about model perf numbers
- 10:15-11:30 implement quick fix for python readme
- Afternoon: pair with Mikaela on node tests, draft tutorial outline

SHORT HAND REMINDERS
- Add note in quickstart: "If you see `ConnectionResetError` during streaming on macOS, upgrade to SDK 0.0.8+ and use the new transport."
- Keep examples minimal: copy-pasteable in <50 lines where possible

END OF SCRATCHPAD
(Will clean up and convert to PR checklist once fixes are validated.)
